Safety Advisor / Occupational Health and Safety Advisor – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $100,000 – $130,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Safety Advisor / Occupational Health and Safety Advisor to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Safety Advisor / Occupational Health and Safety Advisor, you will be responsible for supporting the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of workplace health and safety systems across mining, engineering, maintenance, fabrication, and industrial projects. You will work closely with project managers, supervisors, employees, and contractors to ensure compliance with legislation, company policies, and client safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Implement, maintain, and monitor workplace health and safety systems, policies, and procedures.
•	Provide advice and guidance to management, supervisors, and employees on occupational health and safety matters.
•	Conduct workplace inspections, audits, risk assessments, and safety observations.
•	Identify workplace hazards and recommend appropriate control measures to minimise risks.
•	Assist with incident investigations, reporting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
•	Develop, review, and maintain safety documentation, including SWMS, JSA, risk assessments, and safety reports.
•	Monitor compliance with WHS legislation, Australian Standards, client requirements, and company procedures.
•	Deliver safety inductions, toolbox talks, and training sessions to employees and contractors.
•	Promote a strong safety culture and encourage continuous improvement in workplace practices.
•	Assist project teams with safety planning, mobilisation requirements, and compliance documentation.
•	Maintain safety records, registers, inspection reports, and incident databases.
•	Liaise with clients, contractors, and regulatory bodies regarding health and safety matters where required.
•	Ensure compliance with workplace health, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience as a Safety Advisor, Occupational Health and Safety Advisor, or similar WHS role.
•	Relevant qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, Workplace Health and Safety, or a related discipline.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian WHS legislation, safety management systems, and risk management principles.
•	Experience working within mining, construction, engineering, maintenance, or industrial environments is highly regarded.
•	Ability to conduct workplace inspections, audits, investigations, and safety training.
•	Strong communication, consultation, and problem-solving skills.
•	Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively with project teams.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and safety management systems.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $100,000 – $130,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing professional development and career progression.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

Company: Dharma Bhakti Group Pty Ltd t/a Sunrise Custom Homes
Position Title: Architectural Draftsperson
Location: Adelaide, South Australia, 3061
Salary: AUD 79,500 to 82,000 + Super

About the Business:
Sunrise Custom Homes are Adelaide’s trusted custom home builders. They specialise in fully customisable homes and work closely with each client to bring their vision to life. Whether you’re building your first home or creating an investment property, their expertise and passion ensure your dream becomes a reality.

About the Role:
They are seeking a skilled and motivated Architectural Draftsperson to join their team. This hands-on position requires strong technical capability in drafting and documentation, along with a commitment to accuracy and high-quality design outcomes. The ideal candidate will be proficient in industry-standard drafting software and confident in reading, interpreting, and producing detailed architectural drawings. You’ll play a key role in transforming concepts into build-ready documentation, contributing directly to the delivery of custom homes.

Minimum Requirements:
Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Building Design, Architectural Drafting, Building Design Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent qualification.
Minimum 1–3 years' experience in architectural drafting or building design within Australian residential construction projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare detailed architectural drawings, construction documentation and working drawings for residential dwellings, custom homes, renovations and property development projects using CAD and Revit software.
Develop concept drawings, floor plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation based on client requirements, architectural designs and engineering specifications.
Produce accurate working drawings in accordance with the National Construction Code (NCC), relevant Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Prepare detailed documentation including structural layouts, site plans, floor plans, roof plans, drainage layouts, service layouts and construction details for residential projects.
Modify and customise existing home designs and floor plans to suit client preferences, site conditions, budget requirements and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate drawings and documentation with architects, engineers, building designers, surveyors, certifiers, energy assessors, consultants, builders and project managers to ensure design accuracy and project consistency.
Liaise with clients and project stakeholders to gather project information and translate design concepts into accurate technical drawings.
Prepare documentation required for Development Applications (DA), Planning Approvals, Building Approvals, Council submissions and other statutory approval processes.
Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings to identify inconsistencies, drafting errors and construction issues prior to project commencement.
Amend, revise and update drawings based on client feedback, council requirements, consultant recommendations, engineering input and design changes throughout the design and construction process.
Assist with project coordination, planning approvals and construction documentation throughout all stages of residential projects.
Prepare schedules for doors, windows, finishes, fixtures and fittings to support construction documentation and procurement.
Assist in preparing material quantities, preliminary cost estimates and design documentation for tendering and project planning purposes.
Conduct site measurements and inspections where required to verify existing conditions and ensure drafting accuracy for renovations, custom homes and development projects.
Collaborate with construction supervisors, site teams and project managers to resolve design-related queries during construction and issue updated documentation where required.
Maintain accurate electronic records of drawings, revisions, project documentation and version control using the company's document management systems.
Research and apply current building regulations, planning policies, residential construction methods and sustainable design principles to ensure ongoing compliance and improve project outcomes.

Essential Skills
Proficient in CAD and Revit software for producing accurate architectural drawings and construction documentation.
Strong understanding of residential construction methods, detailing, building systems and construction processes.
Thorough knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Ability to interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and consultant documentation.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to prepare accurate, compliant and high-quality documentation.
Excellent communication and coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with clients, engineers, consultants, builders, site teams and project managers.
Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Sound problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve drafting and design issues throughout project delivery.

How to Apply:
To apply for this position, please email your resume to info@nextgentalent.com.au. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted, and your application will be treated as strictly confidential

result.description:
ShawX Manufacturing

ShawX Manufacturing is a proudly Australian-owned engineering and manufacturing company based in Queensland, specialising in innovative heavy vehicle solutions for the construction, mining, transport, and waste management industries.
As our business continues to grow, we are looking for motivated and hands-on Metal Fabricators to join our team in Cleveland.

Job summary:

The Metal Fabricator is responsible for fabricating, assembling, modifying, and repairing metal components and structures in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications, and production requirements. The role involves preparing metal materials, cutting, shaping, welding, assembling, finishing, and inspecting fabricated products to ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance with workplace safety standards.
The position requires practical skills in metal fabrication, welding processes, interpretation of technical drawings, and the safe operation of fabrication equipment.

Responsibilities:
-  Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, work instructions, and specifications to determine job requirements.
-  Measure, mark, cut, shape, and prepare metal materials including steel, aluminium, and other fabricated components.
-  Select appropriate materials, tools, and fabrication methods for each job.
-  Fabricate metal components and assemblies using hand tools, power tools, and workshop machinery.
-  Assemble fabricated components using welding, bolting, fastening, and mechanical joining techniques.
-  Ensure fabricated products meet dimensional accuracy and quality requirements.
-  Perform welding operations using appropriate welding techniques
-  Set up welding equipment and select suitable welding parameters based on material type and thickness.
-  Align and position components prior to welding.
-  Inspect welds for quality, penetration, appearance, and structural integrity.
-  Carry out welding repairs, modifications, and rework where required.
-  Operate fabrication equipment such as cutting saws, grinders, drills and other metal processing equipment
-  Cut metal sections and shapes according to drawings and measurements.
-  Shape and modify metal components using mechanical methods and controlled heating where required.
-  Grind, clean, dress, and finish fabricated components.
-  Check finished products against drawings, measurements, and customer specifications.
-  Identify fabrication defects and complete corrective work.
-  Maintain quality standards throughout the fabrication process.

Qualification & Skills
-  Trade qualification in Metal Fabrication or equivalent qualification
-  3+ years of experience in metal fabrication within a workshop/manufacturing environment
-  Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans.
-  Experience with metal cutting, grinding, welding, and assembly processes.
-  Ability to measure and mark metal accurately.
-  Experience using hand tools and workshop machinery.
-  Understanding of welding processes and fabrication techniques.
-  Ability to work independently and as part of a production team.

Why Join ShawX?
-  Be part of a growing Australian manufacturing success story
-  Work on innovative and specialised heavy vehicle products
-  Supportive team environment with opportunities to grow your skills
-  Stable full-time position with competitive pay
-  Opportunity to contribute to industry-leading manufacturing solutions

Pay 
- AUD 79500 - 85000 per annum excluding superannuation 

If you are looking for a rewarding hands-on role within a growing business, we would love to hear from you.
